title: Keep objectives and cited facts
statement: Keep learning objectives and cited facts as two levels of a single store, since either source alone can lose much of what the other holds.
example: In one course, 39% of the objective-level entries had no match among the facts, and 99.8% of the facts had no match among the objectives.
detail: Comparing two AP curriculum sources for one course showed they sat at different levels of the official hierarchy: 39% of objective-level entries had no match among the facts, and 99.8% of the facts had no match among the objectives (`icloud-work/auto-memory-backup/feedback_oracle_source_reconciliation.md`, line 44). One source alone lost 1,049 cited facts; the other alone lost 838 sub-objective breakdowns with misconceptions (line 30). Tagging to the objectives with the facts beneath is the note's plan, not a tested result.
against: In another course one source was kept as primary and backfilled, and there the sources overlapped heavily: "78% of curriculum repo APWH content is already in InceptBench (with matching CB-format KC IDs)." (`icloud-work/auto-memory-backup/feedback_oracle_source_reconciliation.md`, line 40). The analysis covered "Histories (APUSH, APWH, APEURO) only — non-history AP subjects not analyzed." (line 8), and the merge has no recorded result.

evidence.quote: The two sets are at different tiers of the CB hierarchy.

39% of curriculum repo APUSH has no InceptBench match; 99.8% of InceptBench's atomic facts have no curriculum match. **Best path: merge them — use curriculum repo as the canonical tagging skeleton, layer InceptBench's atomic facts as the evidence tier underneath.**
- **APUSH with either alone**: curriculum-only loses 1,049 atomic facts; InceptBench-only loses 838 sub-KC pedagogical decompositions with common-misconceptions. Single-source halves the pedagogy.
78% of curriculum repo APWH content is already in InceptBench (with matching CB-format KC IDs).
Histories (APUSH, APWH, APEURO) only — non-history AP subjects not analyzed.
